title: 1.1 Common Terms in Crop Production (Easy)
description: Definitions of agriculture, shifting cultivation, settled agriculture and subsistence farming

questions.question: Agriculture is defined as the
options: The hunting of wild animals and gathering of plants for food
Deliberate cultivation of crops and rearing of animals
Clearing forest and shifting to new land each season
Mass production of crops and animals for export markets
questions.correctAnswer: Deliberate cultivation of crops and rearing of animals

questions.question: Hunter-gatherers remain mainly in areas with
options: Land and climate unsuited to crops
questions.correctAnswer: Land and climate unsuited to crops

questions.question: Shifting cultivation clears land and cultivates it for
options: A few years and then abandoning it
Many years of continuous cropping without r
questions.correctAnswer: A few years and then abandoning it

questions.question: Settled agriculture uses the same plot of land
options: Only during the rainy season of every single year
It reflects generations of local experience
Continuously for a very long period of time
Fertilizer application by the local farmers
questions.correctAnswer: Continuously for a very long period of time

questions.question: Settled agriculture is more advanced than
options: The traditional system of shifting cultivation
It began in one single known location on earth
Abandonment of the land after only a few years
Large scale commercial plantation farming systems
questions.correctAnswer: The traditional system of shifting cultivation
